summaryZh: Furnari Laboratory 研究恶性脑肿瘤，特别是胶质母细胞瘤的遗传、信号与微环境机制及治疗抵抗。实验室使用患者来源和基因工程 iPSC 来源模型寻找治疗薄弱点。
researchQuestions: 遗传因素、细胞信号与肿瘤微环境如何影响成人和儿童恶性脑肿瘤的疾病行为和治疗反应？

evidence.quote: Furnari Laboratory Advancing Brain Cancer Biology and Therapy
Our research explores the genetic, molecular, and microenvironmental mechanisms that allow these tumors to grow, evolve, and resist therapy.
Using patient- and genetically engineered iPSC-derived models, we work to identify new therapeutic vulnerabilities and treatment strategies

Our research centers on understanding the biology of malignant brain tumors, by exploring how genetics, cell signaling, and the tumor microenvironment shape disease behavior and treatment response in adults and pediatric patients.
